message.reasoning_content:
Looking at the image: Omega De Ville, silver/white dial with Roman numerals, date at 3 o'clock, "CO-AXIAL CHRONOMETER" text, steel case (looks steel), black leather strap, blue hands? Hands look blue (blued) or silver. The dial is silver-white with Roman numerals.

This looks like Omega De Ville Prestige Co-Axial Chronometer, 39.5mm or 36mm. Reference 424.13.40.20.02.001? That's the De Ville Prestige Co-Axial 39.5mm with silver dial, Roman numerals... Hmm.

Actually 424.13.40.20.02.001 — De Ville Prestige Co-Axial 39.5 mm, steel on leather strap (13 = steel with... wait, group BB first digit 4? No, 424 collection = De Ville Prestige; BB = 13 → metal 1 steel, strap 3 = alligator leather). CC = 40 → 40mm? Actually 40 = 39.5mm rounded. DD = 20 movement co-axial. EE = 02 silver dial. FFF = 001.

So 424.13.40.20.02.001 fits: De Ville Prestige, steel, leather strap, 39.5mm, silver dial with Roman numerals. The dial here has Roman numerals at 12, 3(?), 6, 9 and stick markers elsewhere. Actually looks like Roman numerals applied at 12, 6, 9... Hmm the photo shows Roman numerals at 12, 3 (date?), 9, and 6? Hard to tell.

There's also 424.13.40.20.02.002? Or 424.13.40.20.02.003 (with small seconds). The standard De Ville Prestige Co-Axial Chronometer 39.5mm silver dial Roman numerals is 424.13.40.20.02.001.

Wait but there's also a variant with Roman numerals: "424.13.40.20.02.002" is the silver dial with Roman numerals? Let me think. Omega De Ville Prestige Co-Axial 39.5 mm ref 424.13.40.20.02.001 has a silver dial with Roman numerals? I recall 424.13.40.20.02.001 = silver dial, Roman numerals... Actually, I think there are: 424.13.40.20.02.001 (silver dial with Roman numerals, leather), 424.13.40.20.02.002, 424.13.40.20.02.003 (blue), 424.13.40.20.02.004 (champagne). Hmm.

Hmm, historically, the De Ville Prestige Co-Axial 39.5mm with "opaline silver dial with Roman numerals" — I believe the reference is 424.13.40.20.02.001. There's also a "blued hands" version? Actually in the photo the hands appear dark/blue-ish, which corresponds to the "De Ville Prestige" with... Hmm.

Actually there's a known De Ville Prestige 39.5mm with silver dial, Roman numerals and blued (or black) hands: 424.13.40.20.02.001? The standard has rhodium-plated hands.

Actually, I recall the De Ville Prestige "Co-Axial Chronometer" 39.5mm steel on leather: ref. 424.13.40.20.02.001 with silver dial. Hmm. But the dial in photo also has a small "SWISS MADE" at 6.

Hmm, alternatively there's the older 2012 model De Ville Prestige Co-Axial 38.7mm: 4813.30.01 or 4374.31?

I'll go with 424.13.40.20.02.001, De Ville Prestige, automatic, steel, leather, confidence ~0.4.

Wait, but the date window at 3 o'clock with white date wheel. And "CO-AXIAL CHRONOMETER" text. Yeah.

Actually let me reconsider: the dial seems to have alternating Roman numerals and stick markers — Roman at 12, and at 12 only? Let me look: at top "XII" appears as roman; at 9 there's "IX"? I see at left "IX"? The image shows something at 9 position that looks like a Roman numeral. And at 6 as well. Yes, De Ville Prestige with Roman numerals at 12, 3(?), 6, 9 and batons elsewhere — that's a signature of the De Ville Prestige "Romain" dial.

Actually the classic De Ville Prestige 424.13.40.20.02.001 has a silver dial with Roman numerals at 12, 3, 6, 9 (but date at 3). Hmm.

OK, go with confidence 0.45.
